tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find Wisty UI components by the job they do, ranked best first. Use one to three short keywords, like "record picker", "picklist", "toast" or "confirm delete", not a sentence. tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every Wisty UI item by kind, with its name and first sentence, optionally only one kind. Primitives are shadcn's own components with the Salesforce look; components are what shadcn lacks, like lookup; blocks are Salesforce assemblies over sample data; helpers turn records into a block's props.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: Get the code of one example of a Wisty UI item, for the project's base: a complete, working use you can adapt. Without example, the first one, which shows the job the item is for. tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Get the steps to install one Wisty UI item with the shadcn CLI: the npx shadcn command, the theme step that writes Wisty UI's theme into the project's stylesheet once, and, for an item that draws Salesforce icons, the step that copies their sprites to the app's static files. Read style and tailwind.
